name: Starfish
summary: A selection technique for dense scenes where a starfish-shaped cursor reaches out to the targets nearest the pre-selected one.
howItWorks: After the cursor is placed in a dense region, branches extend to the closest candidates; the user moves along a branch to select the intended target.
